At the Mohammed bin Rashid Leadership Forum, Abdulrahman Saleh Al Saleh, Director General of the Government of Dubai's Department of Finance (DOF), highlighted Dubai’s competitiveness as a leading global financial centre. The session, attended by prominent financial sector leaders and experts, also discussed the rapid transformations shaping the global financial sector and their impact on the region, Dubai’s readiness for these changes, and the importance of supporting innovation in finance.

Real estate leaders mapped out the next phase in strengthening Dubai’s position as a global investment destination during the Mohammed bin Rashid Leadership Forum. Led by Omar Hamad Bushahab, Director General of the Dubai Land Department, the session addressed the sector’s challenges, explored new opportunities for growth and innovation, and considered ways to develop a shared vision that supports the real estate market’s competitiveness.

At a keynote session during the Mohammed bin Rashid Leaders Forum, Issam Kazim, CEO of the Dubai Corporation for Tourism and Commerce Marketing (DCTCM), described how Dubai has turned every challenge into an opportunity for success through the wisdom of its leadership. Dubai’s story is a living example of an ambitious vision translated into a strategy for action and development, making global leadership a reality we experience every day. Dubai continues to build on its leading position by embracing advanced technologies and AI-powered solutions. When the world thinks of the future, Dubai is the first place that comes to mind.
